task: Given a set of 2n coins, each biased with a different value for the probability of heads, pick a set of coins that gives the highest probability that when tossed, the number of heads will be n
rationale: Requires dynamic programming or combinatorial optimization to evaluate probability distributions across different coin subsets. Must calculate binomial probabilities for each potential n-coin selection and compare outcomes. The exponential search space (C(2n,n) possibilities) and probabilistic calculations make this computationally complex.
